The fastest zap is still a payment rule.

Our 1 minute 49 second tutorial follows one zap through 5 steps. The companion guide explains WebLN, per-site permission and auto-approve examples at 21, 100 and 500 sats. A threshold of 0 requires manual approval every time.

Speed should stop where the rule stops.

We published the walkthrough and its seven-language guide so people can test one payment, review the recipient and amount, then choose a limit they can explain. What threshold would you notice before it became a habit?

Auto-approve does not grant WebLN permission. It only applies after a site is allowed to request payments, and every zap remains visible in wallet history.
